description: UK local-area Ledger target references for constituency and local-authority calibration. Rows are generated from the local rows in uk_population_targets.json and local_area_crosswalk.json: name is target_id@geography_id, ledger_selector is the contract selector plus geography_level/geography_id pins, entity and measure come from the policyengine binding, and observed values stay in Ledger facts. Deferred area absences are recorded in the membership report.
